Container.Name: testerfy
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: spotify playlist music discovery oauth like dislike curation
Container.Overview:
Testerfy — fast Spotify playlist curation. Like saves to target playlists and skips; dislike removes and skips. Logs decisions with timestamps, listening stats, and undo support.
Requires Spotify Premium and a Spotify Developer App. Spotify OAuth needs a public HTTPS redirect URI — see project documentation for redirect URI and HTTPS setup (reverse proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel, optional Tailscale Serve, etc.).
Setup: https://github.com/ozmoetr/testerfy#setup

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Container port. Expose via your chosen HTTPS front-end (see project README).

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Database and config storage. Back this up to preserve your history.

Config.Name: Spotify Shared Path
Config.Description: Shared rate-limit state with Mellodex (same Spotify Client ID). Mount rw in both apps.

Config.Name: Spotify Shared Dir
Config.Description: In-container path for cross-app Spotify ecosystem files

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: From developer.spotify.com → Dashboard → Your App → Settings

Config.Name: Spotify Client Secret
Config.Description: From developer.spotify.com → Dashboard → Your App → Settings → View client secret

Config.Name: Spotify Redirect URI
Config.Description: Public HTTPS callback URL — must match your Spotify Developer Dashboard exactly (see project README)

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random security key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
